translated_text: Liginia, November 2, 1940. My Bobchen, my darling love, I wrote you three letters; - the first, the second, the third, precisely after Roland's door. As you go, I don't believe that in Narbonne, I only say that I am in Figiniac with all the family and I am waiting for news to know when and how I will see you again. I will stay here until I receive precise news, of faith on this subject. I am well, my only thing is I love you. I didn't know that it was possible for years.
